description:
[Deterministic regulatory assessment. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free, no external state modified]. Assesses Threat-Led Penetration Testing (TLPT) mandatory obligations and scoping under DORA Articles 26-27 and Joint RTS JC 2024 15 (TIBER-EU framework). Evaluates financial sector type, balance sheet assets (≥30B€ threshold), systemically important institution (G-SII/O-SII) designation, 3-year recurring testing cadence, and required independent external tester qualifications.
Usage: Use this tool specifically to determine whether a financial entity is legally mandated to conduct live red-team / TLPT penetration testing under DORA. Do NOT use for general ICT incident classification (use 'incident_severity_triage' instead) or for vendor contract audits (use 'dora_third_party_risk' instead).
Returns: JSON object with { isObliged: boolean, rationale: string, recommendedFrequency: string, requiredTesterType: 'EXTERNAL_ACCREDITED' | 'INTERNAL_PERMITTED', legalBasis: string, nextTestDueBy: string | null }.

annualTransactionVolumeMillionEur.description: Annual transaction volume in million EUR

financialSector.description: DORA financial sector classification under Article 2(1)

isSystemicallyImportant.description: Whether officially designated as G-SII or O-SII by ECB/EBA

lastTlptTestDate.description: Last TLPT test completion date in YYYY-MM-DD format

outsourcedCriticalFunctions.description: List of outsourced critical financial functions supporting core services

testerType.description: Type of penetration testers utilized (TIBER-EU accreditation)

totalBalanceSheetAssetsMillionEur.description: Total balance sheet assets in million EUR (statutory threshold is 30,000 M€)

name: tlpt_threat_led_pentest_scope
